brief:
Israeli occupation forces have continued bulldozing Palestinian agricultural land near the Tubas plains in the northern West Bank, the Ma'an news agency reported. The operations targeted farming areas in the region, destroying crops and infrastructure used by local residents.

The demolitions are part of ongoing Israeli military activity in the area, which has regularly subjected Palestinian-held territory to such operations. Residents have faced repeated land seizures and construction restrictions that prevent development of their communities.
title: Israeli forces continue land leveling near Tubas plains
